=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- scripts/review_rb_judge.sh:2309-2316 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: In rb_judge_merge_retry_transient the already_merged branch returns 0 before comparing the PR head to RB_JUDGED_HEAD_SHA, so a merge of a different head counts as success.
  WHY: Callers then set RB_MERGE_STATUS=merge_requested or MERGE_CONFIRMED=true on code the judge never evaluated, while the auto_merge_enabled branch does check the head. Reviewers rated it MAJOR.
- scripts/review_rb_judge.sh:2325-2328 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The retry helper re-issues gh pr merge after 10/20/40s sleeps without re-running _pr_base_fresh_for_merge.
  WHY: If the base advances during the retry window (up to 70s), the merge can land against a base the freshness gate would have deferred. Reviewers rated it MAJOR. anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 considered this and did not report it, judging the risk low.
- scripts/review_rb_judge.sh:2328-2330 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: No PR state read follows the third retry's merge attempt, so the helper returns 1 even if the merge landed server-side despite an error.
  WHY: A merged PR is reported as merge_failed or sync_merge_failed, and the sync path skips the follow-up. Severity disagreement: z-ai_glm-5_3-flash rated it NIT (fail-safe, a false-negative report), and the others rated it MAJOR. The highest is used.

=== FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===
- scripts/review_rb_judge.sh:2309-2316 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: The `_rb_retry_merged = true` branch in `rb_judge_merge_retry_transient` returns 0 before the `_rb_retry_head != RB_JUDGED_HEAD_SHA` check, so an already-merged PR is accepted without checking the head.
  WHY: Another actor can push a new head and merge during the 10/20/40s wait. The helper then returns 0 with outcome=already_merged and callers proceed as if the judged code had merged. The existing test only covers a matching head.
- HARDENING: scripts/review_rb_judge.sh line 2309, move the head_moved check (lines 2313-2316) above the merged=true check (about 4 lines). HARDENING_RISK_SCORE: 2
- Reviewer explicitly did not report two consensus findings: no new `_pr_base_fresh_for_merge` check before a retry, and no PR read after the third retry. It judged both low-risk.
=== END FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===

=== FINDINGS FROM google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite ===
- scripts/review_rb_judge.sh:2309-2312 | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The function returns success (0) on the already_merged path without verifying that the merged PR head matches RB_JUDGED_HEAD_SHA.
  WHY: If another actor merges a different head during the retry sleep, the judge treats it as a successful merge of the judged head and proceeds to a sync or terminal follow-up on unjudged code.
- scripts/review_rb_judge.sh:rb_judge_merge_retry_transient (function body) | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The retry loop re-issues gh pr merge after delays without re-verifying base freshness via _pr_base_fresh_for_merge.
  WHY: If the base moves during the 10s/20s/40s sleeps, the retried merge is based on stale code and violates the freshness gate contract.
- scripts/review_rb_judge.sh:2284-2330 | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: No PR read is performed after the final (third) merge retry fails at line 2328.
  WHY: If the last retry succeeded server-side despite a transient error, the function returns 1 and the caller reports a merge failure even though the PR is merged.
=== END FINDINGS FROM google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite ===

=== FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m3 ===
- scripts/review_rb_judge.sh:rb_judge_merge_retry_transient (merged-check relative to head-mismatch check) | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: When the REST read returns merged=true the function returns 0 before comparing _rb_retry_head to RB_JUDGED_HEAD_SHA, unlike the neighboring auto_merge_enabled branch.
  WHY: A concurrent push and merge during the sleep leaves the PR merged at a new head. The merge, merge_with_followup and terminal sites then act on code the judge never evaluated. --match-head-commit cannot catch this, and the existing test covers only the matching head.
- scripts/review_rb_judge.sh:rb_judge_merge_retry_transient (retried gh pr merge --match-head-commit calls vs. _pr_base_fresh_for_merge gate) | severity=MAJOR | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: The freshness gate runs once at the call site before the first gh pr merge. The helper then sleeps 10/20/40s and re-issues the merge three more times without re-checking it.
  WHY: If RB_BASE_REF advances during the 10-70s window, the helper merges a PR the script's own contract says must not be merged against that base.
- scripts/review_rb_judge.sh:rb_judge_merge_retry_transient (`for _rb_retry_delay in 10 20 40` loop, final gh pr merge to trailing `return 1`) | severity=MAJOR | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: The PR state read happens only at the top of each loop iteration. After the third retry's merge fails with a 5xx, control reaches `return 1` with no second read.
  WHY: A PR that GitHub merged during the final attempt is reported as merge_failed or sync_merge_failed, requiring a manual merge.
=== END FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m3 ===

=== FINDINGS FROM openai_gpt-6-luna ===
- scripts/review_rb_judge.sh:2309-2315 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The helper returns success for _rb_retry_merged=true before checking whether the PR head still matches RB_JUDGED_HEAD_SHA.
  WHY: If another actor advances and merges during a retry delay, the caller can mark linked issues ready to merge, or on the sync path set MERGE_CONFIRMED=true and create a follow-up on unjudged code.
- scripts/review_rb_judge.sh:2325-2328; freshness checks at 2417, 2510, and 3039 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The retry helper reissues the merge without rerunning _pr_base_fresh_for_merge, and retries extend the operation by up to 70 seconds.
  WHY: If the base advances and changes files the PR touches, the retry is still issued with only --match-head-commit and can merge without the overlap check that would defer it.
- scripts/review_rb_judge.sh:2328-2330 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: After the third retry attempt fails, the helper returns failure without another PR-state read.
  WHY: A final merge applied by GitHub but returning a server error is reported as merge_failed or sync_merge_failed even though the PR is merged, and the sync path then skips the follow-up.
=== END FINDINGS FROM openai_gpt-6-luna ===

=== FINDINGS FROM z-ai_glm-5_3-flash ===
- scripts/review_rb_judge.sh:2309-2316 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The already_merged success path never compares the PR's live head SHA against RB_JUDGED_HEAD_SHA. Line 2311 returns success before the head_moved guard at 2313, which is therefore unreachable in this case. The preceding parse block (2303-2308) was edited without fixing this ordering.
  WHY: A merge that includes newer, unjudged commits is reported as a successful judged merge, and downstream follow-up work is created on top of code the judge never approved.
- scripts/review_rb_judge.sh:2326, 2328 (freshness gates at 2404/2417, 2497/2510, 3039; retry hooks at 2432, 2525, 3076) | severity=MAJOR | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: The retry helper re-issues the merge after 10, 20 and 40 second delays without re-running _pr_base_fresh_for_merge. The retry path bypasses both gate invocations because it is entered only after they have passed.
  WHY: If the base moves under files the PR touches during the retry window, the retried merge lands a PR validated against a base the gate now considers stale.
- scripts/review_rb_judge.sh:2328-2330 (feeding failure paths at line 2440 and line 3084) | severity=NIT | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: After the third retry's merge attempt fails, the loop exits with no final PR read, although the helper reads before each retry because the failed call may have landed server-side (comment at line 2285).
  WHY: A merge that landed while gh reported a 5xx is reported as merge_failed or sync_merge_failed. The reviewer notes this is fail-safe, a false-negative report and not a wrong action.
- HARDENING: scripts/review_rb_judge.sh:2301-2308, when the per-retry REST read is unreadable the helper retries with no distinct log line. Suggested: emit an `outcome=unreadable` RB_JUDGE_MERGE_RETRY line and update agents.d/8524-rb-judge-merge-transient-retry.md (about 3 lines). HARDENING_RISK_SCORE: 1
=== END FINDINGS FROM z-ai_glm-5_3-flash ===
